Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 117. 相似的字符串

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> p;

    int numSimilarGroups(vector<string>& strs) {
        int n = strs.size();
        p.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) p[i] = i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j)
                if (check(strs[i], strs[j]))
                    p[find(i)] = find(j);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            if (i == find(i))
                ++ans;
        return ans;
    }

    bool check(string a, string b) {
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i)
            if (a[i] != b[i])
                ++cnt;
        return cnt <= 2;
    }

    int find(int x) {
        if (p[x] != x) p[x] = find(p[x]);
        return p[x];
    }
};
